blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A 57-year-old motorcycle rider on his way home from a dialysis session died, while an elderly pedestrian was injured in a road crash in Pitogo town on Wednesday evening. Police Capt. Derf Jay Maquinta, spokesperson of the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office, said the incident occurred around 6 p.m. in Purok Potato, Barangay Poblacion. Initial investigation by the Pitogo Municipal Police Station (MPS) showed that the victim, driving a red Honda RSX motorcycle from Pagadian City toward Barangay Panubigan, accidentally hit a 76-year-old pedestrian who was crossing the road.
